descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
ROBIN HOOD is VR archery the way it should feel: a real longbow in your hands, in a bright storybook Sherwood Forest.

A REAL BOW
Hold the bow out in one hand. Bring the other hand to the string, squeeze, and draw it back to your cheek. The pull clicks in your hand, the string snaps when you let go, and a longer draw sends the arrow faster and flatter. Left-handed archers can swap hands.

TEN TALES, FIVE PLACES
A sunny glade, a river crossing, the Sheriff's autumn road, Nottingham Fair and Sherwood in winter. Every Tale is a run of waves with three stars to win.

SO MUCH TO HIT
Bullseyes that tip over when you hit them, targets swinging on ropes, apples on posts, bottles tossed into the air by Friar Tuck, coin pouches you cut down by the rope, barrels drifting down the river, and the Sheriff's tax wagon - shoot the padlock and the chest bursts open with gold.

THE SHERIFF'S MEN
His guards peek out from behind rocks and crates. Hit one and his helmet flies off and he runs for it. Nobody gets hurt.

GOLD FOR THE POOR
Hit streaks raise your multiplier up to x5. Eight hits in a row, or a golden crown shot out of the sky, earns a Golden Arrow worth double. Every coin you rob flies home to your belt.

ROBIN HOOD'S CAMP
Start under the Major Oak with its treehouse, the campfire and the Merry Men, and warm up on the practice range between Tales.
